title: Large-index continuity of etale representables
statement: For a scheme X in universe u, an affine etale presentation P of det-pe-classical-definition-continuity-map indexed by a small cofiltered category in universe u+1, and an etale object V in the coefficient-sized model of def-weil-pbc-site-comparison-morphism, the covariant hom functor from the corresponding opposite pro-etale object preserves the colimit diagram (P.diagram followed by AsSmall.up).op. Equivalently, maps from the affine limit to V factor through a stage and equality is detected at a later stage. The coefficient-model size max(v,u+1) is independent of the scheme universe.

source.place: lemma-describe-pullback-from-etale and lemma-limit-pullback (Tag 099S); finite-presentation limit criterion

proof.text: Use the sheaf-valued Yoneda equivalences and the comparison adjunction to construct an isomorphism from the inverse image of the lifted etale representable at V to the lifted pro-etale representable at its inclusion. The hom equivalences are natural in the target sheaf, so Coyoneda.ext constructs this isomorphism with no new mathematical assumption.

Apply the essential-image characterization det-pe-classical-sheaves-image to this isomorphism. Its IsClassical conclusion applies directly to the given affine presentation indexed in universe u+1, and makes the continuityMap of the lifted pro-etale representable bijective. Therefore the specified restriction cocone is colimiting, by IsColimit.ofPointIso applied to the chosen colimit.

A colimit cocone of sets is jointly surjective; its equality relation for a filtered diagram is eventual equality at one later stage. Transfer these two properties from the lifted pro-etale representable to the coefficient-sized opposite hom sets by ULift.up and ULift.down and the opposite-hom equivalence. Types.FilteredColimit.isColimitOf' then proves that coyoneda sends the opposite presentation cone to a colimit. Reflect the given limit along Scheme.ProEt.forget and preserve it along AsSmall.up; apply preservesColimit_of_preserves_colimit_cocone to that opposite cone. This uses the original larger index and keeps the coefficient universe independent.

theorem coefficientComparison_representable_preservesColimit (X : Scheme.{u})
    {I : Type (u + 1)} [SmallCategory I] [IsCofiltered I]
    (P : AffinePresentation X I)
    (V : (Scheme.smallModelComparisonEtaleSite.{u, v} X)ᵒᵖ) :
    PreservesColimit (P.diagram ⋙ AsSmall.up).op
      (coyoneda.obj (op ((Scheme.smallModelComparisonInclusion.{u, v} X).op.obj V)))
